{{Top|leg}}
'''Hejarbo''' was a form of plant life found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Their shoots were used to make huts for the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] to live in.

Their shoots were not strong enough to be made into [[Boat/Legends|boats]] which could withstand the pressure and currents of the [[Western Sea (Kesh)|Western Sea]], but were latticed together to form the gondola on the [[Airship/Legends|airships]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
